summary: Jasper Therapeutics filed an 8-K and press release announcing a tender offer to repurchase warrants issued in its September 18, 2025 underwritten offering. Holders receive $0.324 cash per warrant, without interest, for any and all of the 12,345,707 warrants outstanding as of October 6, 2026; each warrant exercises at $2.92. The offer is open until one minute after 11:59 p.m. ET on November 6, 2026, subject to extension, per an Offer to Purchase dated October 7, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, or financing condition is disclosed. Purpose is reducing potential dilution and providing capital structure certainty.
